businessModels.title: Interactive Kiosk
businessModels.subtitle: Engage customers with interactive product information and promotions.  Great for retail stores, museums, and trade shows.
businessModels.description: This solution provides a touch-screen kiosk that allows customers to browse product information, watch videos, and even complete purchases. Kiosks can be customized with your branding and content.

businessModels.title: Digital Signage Network
businessModels.subtitle: Capture attention and deliver targeted messages across multiple locations. Ideal for restaurants, corporate offices, and transportation hubs.
businessModels.description: Manage and display content on a network of digital signs from a central location. Update menus, promotions, and wayfinding information in real-time. Integrate with data sources for dynamic content.

businessModels.title: Wayfinding & Navigation
businessModels.subtitle: Guide visitors effortlessly throughout your space. Perfect for hospitals, airports, and large campuses.
businessModels.description: Create interactive maps and floor plans that help visitors find their way. Integrate with real-time location services for dynamic guidance. Offer turn-by-turn navigation and accessibility features.

businessModels.title: Self-Service Ordering & Kiosks
businessModels.subtitle: Empower customers to order and pay for products on their own. Well-suited for quick-service restaurants, cafes, and convenience stores.
businessModels.description: Reduce wait times and improve customer experience with self-service kiosks. Allow customers to browse menus, customize orders, and pay with various methods. Integrate with loyalty programs for a seamless experience.

businessModels.title: Menu Boards & Digital Signage
businessModels.subtitle: Showcase your menu items with vibrant visuals and clear information. Perfect for restaurants, cafes, and food courts.
businessModels.description: Replace static menu boards with dynamic digital displays. Display high-resolution images, descriptions, and pricing information. Update menus easily and remotely. Promote special offers and combos effectively.

businessModels.title: Video Wall Displays
businessModels.subtitle: Create immersive experiences and captivating presentations. Ideal for retail stores, event spaces, and control rooms.
businessModels.description: Combine multiple displays to create a seamless video wall. Showcase high-resolution content, live feeds, and interactive elements. Capture attention and make a lasting impression.

businessModels.title: Room Booking & Scheduling
businessModels.subtitle: Manage meeting spaces and resources efficiently. Ideal for offices, co-working spaces, and event venues.
businessModels.description: Enable users to book meeting rooms, conference spaces, and other resources online or through interactive kiosks. Integrate with calendars and directories for real-time availability. Streamline scheduling and reduce conflicts.

businessModels.title: Digital Queue Management
businessModels.subtitle: Reduce wait times and improve customer experience. Works well for banks, hospitals, and government agencies.
businessModels.description: Implement a virtual queueing system that allows customers to join a queue remotely and receive updates on their wait time. Improve customer satisfaction and reduce perceived wait times.

businessModels.title: Customer Feedback & Surveys
businessModels.subtitle: Gather valuable insights from your customers. Applicable to businesses of all types.
businessModels.description: Collect customer feedback through interactive surveys and digital signage displays.  Gain insights into customer satisfaction, preferences, and areas for improvement. Make data-driven decisions to enhance customer experience.

businessModels.title: Employee Training & Onboarding
businessModels.subtitle: Deliver engaging and consistent training content to your workforce. Ideal for businesses of all sizes.
businessModels.description: Create and manage a centralized library of training materials including videos, presentations, and quizzes.  Facilitate employee onboarding, skill development, and compliance training.

ticketSupper.title: API outage: intermittent 500 errors
ticketSupper.description: Multiple endpoints returning 500 since early morning; impact on order processing.

messages.message: We are seeing intermittent 500 errors on /orders and /payments. Began around 07:45 UTC. Please advise.
Triage in progress. Initial logs suggest elevated error rates from the database connection pool.
Hi Jane, we are investigating an upstream DB saturation issue. We will update here as we mitigate.
Update: mitigation deployed to increase pool size and add circuit breakers. Monitoring impact.

ticketSupper.title: Invoice discrepancy for October
ticketSupper.description: Charged for 120 seats but only 100 active users. Please review and credit.

messages.message: Our October invoice shows 120 seats. We only have 100 active users.
Thanks for the details. We will reconcile license usage vs. billing and report back.
Reconciliation started; variance likely due to suspended users not reflected in billing snapshot.
Update: preliminary review indicates 20 suspended users billed in error. Credit request submitted to finance.

ticketSupper.title: Cannot reset password with SSO
ticketSupper.description: Users federated via Azure AD receive an error during password reset flow.

messages.message: Federated users get an error when attempting password reset. SSO via Azure AD.
For federated users, password reset is managed by your IdP. Please have an Azure AD admin reset credentials or disable SSPR override.
Escalating to Azure support to confirm expected behavior with our app registration.
Holding pending vendor confirmation. We will update once we hear back.

ticketSupper.title: Webhook retries failing
ticketSupper.description: Retries stop after second attempt; delivery status stuck in "pending".

messages.message: Webhook retries never exceed 2 attempts. Status remains pending for hours.
Issue reproduced. Likely regression in retry backoff scheduler.
Fix deployed to retry scheduler. Your deliveries should now progress. Please confirm.

ticketSupper.title: Change company name on contract
ticketSupper.description: Legal entity updated; need the subscription contract to reflect new name.

messages.message: Please update the contract to our new legal name.
Received. We'll prepare an amendment and route for e-signature.
Contract updated and fully executed. Closing the ticket.
We were charged twice for invoice INV-2025-1105. Please reverse the duplicate.
Detected duplicate Stripe charge for the same invoice key. Investigating reconciliation job.
We have identified a duplicate payment. Refund is being prepared; we will notify once processed.

ticketSupper.title: Severe latency in EU-West
ticketSupper.description: p95 latency > 3s for read operations from EU-West region.

messages.message: Alert opened: EU-West read latency above threshold for 10 minutes.
Root cause likely noisy neighbor on DB read replicas; rebalancing traffic.
We have shifted read traffic and increased replica capacity. Monitoring latency graphs.
Further tuning underway; planning read-replica replacement during low-traffic window.

ticketSupper.title: Locked out after 2FA device lost
ticketSupper.description: Primary admin lost security key; need emergency recovery.

messages.message: Admin lost their security key. We need recovery ASAP.
We have verified ownership. Temporary codes issued; please rotate keys after login.
Recovery complete and security keys re-enrolled. Resolving.

ticketSupper.title: Feature request: CSV export delimiter
ticketSupper.description: Allow selecting semicolon as delimiter for EU locales.

messages.message: Please add an option to export CSV with semicolon delimiter for EU.
Good suggestion. Logged with product team for prioritization.
Feature accepted. Tentatively targeting Q4; awaiting capacity.

ticketSupper.title: Incorrect DE tax rate applied
ticketSupper.description: VAT calculated at 16% instead of 19% on invoice #2025-0314.

messages.message: Invoice shows 16% VAT; correct rate is 19%.
Confirmed misconfiguration for Germany tax region. Preparing credit note.
Credit memo issued and invoice corrected to 19% VAT. Closing the ticket.

ticketSupper.title: Create additional admin role
ticketSupper.description: Need to delegate billing-only admin to finance team.

messages.message: Requesting a role that can manage billing only, without access to user data.
Thanks, this aligns with our upcoming role templates. We'll share an ETA soon.
Spec drafted for Billing Admin role. Needs security review.

ticketSupper.title: Data import job stuck
ticketSupper.description: Nightly import from S3 not progressing beyond 12%.

messages.message: Import job stalled at 12% for 20 minutes.
Issue traced to a corrupted parquet batch. Re-running from checkpoint.
Job completed successfully. Backfill executed for affected window.

ticketSupper.title: Clarification on seat-based pricing
ticketSupper.description: Need breakdown of costs for seasonal seat increases.

messages.message: Can you provide pricing details when we temporarily add seats during peak season?
We will share a tiered breakdown including proration and volume discounts.
Attached is the draft pricing model for review.

ticketSupper.title: Bank transfer missing
ticketSupper.description: Wire transfer sent on 2025-06-11 not reflected in account.

messages.message: We sent a wire on 2025-06-11. Funds not showing in our account.
We have contacted our payment processor to trace the transfer.
Funds located and applied to your account. Closing the ticket.
